finalists.label: Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific findings, including brownish macules on the hands and feet, hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk, and onychodystrophy, with no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Gastrointestinal lymphoma
finalists.why: It has multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa and numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of specific dermatological findings, such as brownish macules on the hands and feet and hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk, which are characteristic of Peutz-Jeghers Syndrome, decided the final comparison.
